page.notes: Marginal notes on the right were placed at their marks: c, d, e, and the asterisk note. The "SECT. III." label stands beside the subheading and is placed at the start of the following paragraph. The large initial I of "IMò" is joined to the word. The page ends mid-sentence at "Florentinus," and the text continues on the next page. No catchword is visible. The paragraph ending "explica." is followed by a small quotation block. The print is faint in places, especially the margin notes and the lines near "Doctoris", so some letters may be inexact. Printing as found, without correction.
